notes.title: Bow Course Demo Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings Archers![/h1][p]We have an update to the demo's tutorial to make it clearer and easier to understand how to proceed.[/p][h3]
The tutorial update includes:[/h3][list][*][p]Text improvements[/p][/*][*][p]Clearer highlights for buttons & controls[/p][/*][*][p]Destination marker stays visible so players know where to stand[/p][/*][*][p]Player movement is disabled when standing in front of the rules board to reduce confusion [/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for playing the demo! Let us know what you think in the Steam forums and happy archery golfing!
[/p][p]Wishlist the game - Coming soon!
